findings.claim: The JNY-018 split is correct for steps 1, 2 and 6–8. These are operation planning, team composition, opening, active-shifts/operations-map and summary, and they go to CP-05. Steps 4–5 are not fully assigned. In step 4, the agency/technical admin publishes or confirms the normative catalog and mobile package (WF-TEAT-003). In step 5, the supervisor reserves numbering ranges for team devices (WF-TEAT-002). The row sends only 'numbering/catalog distribution' to CP-11. It does not say whether the backoffice-web acts of publishing the catalog and reserving ranges belong to the CP-05 web console or to CP-11. Review-2's own fix wording caused this. It is the same development-vs-operational attribution risk that finding 1 addressed, but much smaller.
findings.fix: State the split explicitly. Either 'CP-05 web catalog publication/confirmation and supervisor numbering-range reservation; CP-11 device-side package distribution, range consumption and sync', or record that both acts are wholly CP-11 and cite the source basis. Do not change the CP-05/CP-11 ownership of any other row.
